# Global Innovation Fund

> > Global Innovation Fund is an impact-first investment vehicle funding social innovations and growth-stage ventures in emerging markets to improve lives through sustainable development.

GIF operates through multiple investment vehicles including the Thrive Fund, 2X Challenge, and GIF Growth Board, with offices in London, Washington DC, and Nairobi. The fund focuses on climate resilience, women empowerment, medtech innovations, and blended finance solutions across Africa and Asia.
